name: The Forgotten Prince's Wing
introDiscord:
A quieter palace wing contains children's rooms, toy chests, miniature
furniture, faded murals, and one royal crest whose name has been removed.
introTwitch:
A quieter palace wing contains children's rooms, toy chests, miniature
furniture, faded murals, and one royal crest whose name has been removed.

the-forgotten-princes-wing-approach.prompt: The Forgotten Prince's Wing opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A Forgotten Prince Revenant emerges beneath the faded crest.

right.message: A toy chest contains Star Candies among wooden knights and tiny boats.

forward.message:
A nursery cabinet contains restorative herbs.

Shizuki wrote:

'Found tiny crown.

Too small for me.

Glimmer fits.

Glimmer is prince now.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

the-forgotten-princes-wing-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Forgotten Prince's Wing, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A child's bedside coffer contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Revenant moves through the nursery corridor.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside a little wooden castle.

Shizuki wrote:

'Someone lived here.

Everyone forgot the name.

That feels unfair.'

the-forgotten-princes-wing-threshold.prompt: Near Nameless Nursery Throne, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A quiet nursery fountain restores strength.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A sealed memory box contains Star Candies and old toy medals.

forward.message: A Forgotten Prince Revenant guards the tiny throne.

bossPromptDiscord:
The nursery mural glows.

A child-sized crown floats above the empty throne.

A spectral heir appears beneath it.

Use /yes to approach the Nameless Nursery Throne or /no to
leave the forgotten room quiet.
bossPromptTwitch:

A spectral heir appears beneath it.

Use !yes to approach the Nameless Nursery Throne or !no to

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Nameless Nursery Throne. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The heir fades.

One name remains impossible to read.

Shizuki's note beneath it says only:

'I don't know who you were.

But somebody found your room again.'
